findings.body:
**Add a caveat beside the partial-mode reproduction command.**

The Reproduction section presents `run --mode partial` at `VM-UNIT-SWITCH-PROOF.md:811-814` with no note. The superseded notice at lines 236-242 states that this harness still asserts the old rc 3 branch and is not evidence for the current recovery gate. Running the command as written therefore reaches that stale assertion and does not reproduce a passing partial proof.

Keep the caveat at the command. Re-baselining the harness is a separate change outside this docs-only diff.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
+# Partial mode still asserts the superseded rc 3 branch. Re-run it on a disposable VM and re-baseline it before citing (see lines 236-242).
 python3 apps/crq-python/ops/vm-unit-switch.py \
   --state-dir "$state" \
   --tools ~/crq-vm-feasibility/tools \
   run --source-commit "$commit" --mode partial
```

</details>
findings.title: Add a caveat beside the partial-mode reproduction command.

findings.body:
**Correct the integration status in the design header.**

The header says the provider "is not wired into the production adapter or controller." Read as a statement about the provider module, that is accurate. Read as a statement about the repository, it conflicts with the live binding. `ops/unit-switch-factory.py` constructs `SystemdJournalCompletionPort` for the production adapter, and the controller CLI reaches that factory through the live binding. The adapter section also says the adapter changes apply "if it is wired later," which describes the same binding as a future step. Update both statements so the document states the current composition.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 2026-11-12. Companion to `ops/unit-completion.py` and
 `test_unit_completion.py`. This is a read-only evidence provider. It does not
-install, start, stop, mask or restore a unit, and it is not wired into the
-production adapter or controller.
+install, start, stop, mask or restore a unit. The module itself does not wire
+into the production adapter or controller. `ops/unit-switch-factory.py`
+constructs `SystemdJournalCompletionPort` for the production adapter, and the
+controller CLI uses that factory through the live binding.
```

</details>

Also replace "The adapter changes, if it is wired later:" in the Minimal adapter proposal with wording that matches the live binding.
findings.title: Correct the integration status in the design header.
